text: Task 8 — Tuning Watershed for Difficult Object Separation The coin-counting system from Task 7 works reasonably well, but some objects are merged while others are incorrectly split. The problem appears to be related to how much of each object is considered sure foreground . Your Task Modify your Task 7 program and investigate the threshold applied to the distance transform. Perform at least four experiments using different distance-transform thresholds . For every experiment record: • Distance-transform threshold Number of detected foreground markers • Number of separated regions Visual quality of segmentation Required Output Create a table such as: Experiment Distance Threshold Foreground Regions Observed Result 1 2 3 4 Then identify the parameter range that gives the most meaningful separation . Do not replace watershed with another segmentation method. This task is specifically about understanding the marker and distance-transform stages from the manual . Talha Shahid 81 Page
